accounting.symbols_excl_cash: CASH is never a symbol; it absorbs residual weight and is excluded from turnover, concentration and drop-one
accounting.long_short_gross_net: long/short books accounted separately; gross = sum(|w|) over non-CASH legs; net = sum(w); cash = 1 - net; all reconciled to 1.0 within 1e-9
accounting.force_flat_fold_boundaries: book forced flat at every fold boundary; boundary sessions carry no cross-fold carry
accounting.min_positions: at least 1 non-CASH leg per decision; min 5 decision periods per fold
accounting.min_decisions_total: at least 30 scored decision periods overall per arm

fills_and_costs.fill_clock: signals computed on session t close data (PIT); fills at next allowed session open-adjacent close-to-close execution consistent with V3 ADJ-1-EXEC-CLOCK; no same-session fill
fills_and_costs.cost_base: 10 bps per side per fill, charged exactly once
fills_and_costs.cost_stress: 20 bps per side per fill for the stress rerun
fills_and_costs.no_double_charge: P1-A2 invariant 2; no sidecar repetition of cost

turnover.convention: turnover = sum(abs(delta_weight)) over non-CASH legs, one named convention (V3 ADJ-5 corrected)
turnover.reporting: annualized two-way; both raw and ceiling-normalized reported

factor_and_benchmark.benchmark: SPY total return (adjusted _all path) per the frozen benchmark contract; identical to V4
factor_and_benchmark.sector_factor: equal-weight sector ETF total return allowed as optional sector factor (authorized data only)
factor_and_benchmark.risk_matched_context: SPY context scaled ex ante by the arm's frozen gross/vol rule; incremental alpha = arm return minus risk-matched SPY context, per fold and overall
factor_and_benchmark.beta_not_alpha: raw PnL or long-equity beta exposure is never accepted as alpha (V2/V3/V4 lesson)

concentration_and_robustness.drop_one_etf: value_book rerun excluding max-contribution symbol; survival = after-drop expectancy > 0
concentration_and_robustness.drop_one_fold: min over folds of expectancy with that fold removed; survival = min > 0

stage_a_gates_carried_forward.causal_control_rule: preregistered per arm; control must NOT reproduce the mechanism; a control that outperforms a negative anchor falsifies the family (confirmatory-region families included)

pit_conditioning_v5.conditioning_lag_rule: a fundamental or macro observation influences decisions no earlier than its availability stamp plus one session; implemented as available_time_utc < 00:00 UTC of the decision session (research/assets/stocks/pit_conditioning.session_gate_utc); regression-pinned at the gate boundary
pit_conditioning_v5.availability_semantics: SEC filed dates are date-only: availability is the end of the filed UTC day (conservative upper bound); retrieval time never substitutes for availability; ALFRED vintage dates would carry the same end-of-day bound if macro were authorized
pit_conditioning_v5.authorized_conditioning_sources: SEC_EDGAR only for V5 (Submissions + Company Facts); every other fusion source is CANDIDATE_NOT_AUTHORIZED or out-of-scope and any arm reading one fails closed
pit_conditioning_v5.sector_aggregation_mechanism: single-vintage equal-weight mean over sorted filers (math.fsum), survivorship-aware via the max_filing_gap_days filing-clock rule; coverage (filers_included/filers_mapped) reported per observation
pit_conditioning_v5.aggregation_parameter_declaration: max_filing_gap_days and the conditioning field(s) are proposal-level design choices that MUST be declared ex ante in the family freeze before any scoring; they are never tuned after scored PnL is visible
pit_conditioning_v5.filer_panel_freeze: the panel in .staging_sec/panel.json is frozen at P2; current-registry survivorship tilt documented and constant across all arms; no filer may be added or removed after selection freeze
pit_conditioning_v5.no_ohlcv_proxy_rule: fabricating fundamental or macro proxies from OHLCV fields is forbidden (plan 6.P2); price-derived conditioners live in the non-forbidden price/volume space only, outside PIT claims

section_1_1_confirmatory_region.vol_level_family_requirements: if a vol-level confirmatory family is proposed: risk overlay (vol targeting / beta hedge / gross clamp) chosen BEFORE any V5 data is scored; preregistered confirmatory status recorded in family verdict and denominator; own falsification control (e.g. one-quarter-stale vol-level ranks) distinct from V4 control arms; A7-N measures rank correlation vs the V4 semivariance anchor with |rho| <= 0.20 and documents the relation to the level axis; Stage-A gates apply with no relaxation; MDD <= 15% is not negotiable
section_1_1_confirmatory_region.v4_control_raw_pnl_status: +53.14% raw (vol-level control) and +14.91% raw (stale-rank control) are NOT evidence and NOT targets

resource_and_timeout.heavy_cap: 1 by default on 8 GB host; set only by fresh probe
resource_and_timeout.execution_timeout_per_cell: 120 minutes hard; safe-stop with < 45 min remaining
resource_and_timeout.serial_cells: scored arms within one family are serial; A1 serializes all publication

carried_payload.frozen_before: V5-D1 proposal wave; changing anything above after proposals are written requires owner adjudication

liquidity_band_cost_model.note: preregistered at P3 BEFORE any V8 returns are examined; bands by trailing 63-session median dollar volume (ADV) as-of each decision date (PIT, availability = session close + 1); cost stays linear in fills (L-V14-0); multipliers applied to booked PnL, never a sidecar (FX V2 M-F1 lesson)
liquidity_band_cost_model.band_definition: ADV63 = median(close*volume) over the 63 sessions ending at the decision session

bands.status: UNTRADABLE_AT_DECISION - excluded from eligibility at that decision

liquidity_band_cost_model.compatibility: a band-A fill has exactly V4/V5 arithmetic (10/20 bps)
liquidity_band_cost_model.raw_series_convention: prices RAW series primary (V6 corporate_actions policy); RAW close*volume for ADV, RAW fill prices with split/dividend adjustment handled by the frozen corporate-actions module

universe_eligibility_frozen_before_retur: name servable by the authorized price authority at that decision date (reconciliation p0a_cohort_price_reconciliation)
ADV63 >= 2_000_000 USD (band C or better) at the decision
price RAW >= 1.00 USD at the decision (sub-dollar microstructure exclusion)

conditioning_block.pit_semantics: multi-vintage: a decision at t observes the latest filed vintage with avail < gate(t); never the latest vintage in the store (V6 canonical)
conditioning_block.clock_rule: a proposal may cite only clocks in the frozen 154-clock set (p0a_clock_freeze.json sha256 61e15738...); any other clock is UNFUNDED and its proposal is ineligible
conditioning_block.conditioning_fields: census fields of the frozen panel; coverage floors from p0a_coverage_census.json

v8_additions.margin_to_fail_reporting: per LESSONS P-2: every Stage-A gate report on a survivor must include the distance to its failure threshold (margin-to-fail), computed at scoring time
v8_additions.availability_convention: daily bars readable at session close + 1 session (V7 Friday-bar-Saturday-present baseline; EODHD EOD publication semantics per probe G5)

kernel_fixes_carried.L_I3_band_resolution: fail-closed: a traded name without a computed band at costing raises BandResolutionError (research/assets/stocks/kernel_band_cost_v9.py); the silent 10bps fallback is forbidden
kernel_fixes_carried.F_A7T_1_ledger: scored ledgers carry driver-emitted counters only; publication bookkeeping lives in a separate append-only record and never edits driver output

death_inclusive_universe.cohort: 410 ALIVE_EVIDENCED (frozen panel) + 1550 DEAD_PRICE_CONFIRMED (census candidate + EODHD symbol join + price-death reconciliation); 219 NOT_DEAD_PRICE_SURVIVAL excluded with recorded reasons; 513 GAP_COVERAGE recorded

dead_name_book_semantics_PREREGISTERED.eligibility: a name is eligible at a decision only with >=63 bars through it (inherited floor) and a non-UNTRADABLE band
dead_name_book_semantics_PREREGISTERED.fill_check: a fill references only names with a bar at the fill session; missing bar = the order does not exist (no silent substitute pricing)
dead_name_book_semantics_PREREGISTERED.exit: a held name whose series ends is exited at its last recorded close on its final session (delisting-return leg carried by the price series itself; no synthetic penalty, no synthetic continuation)
dead_name_book_semantics_PREREGISTERED.forbidden: no survivorship re-substitution: a dead name is never replaced by a successor entity's series

dead_leg_clock_funding.citing_rule: D1 proposals may cite only clocks in the dead-leg funded set (or the price leg); anything else is UNFUNDED and its proposal is ineligible
